page_title: MON 1-0 UNI | B. Monchengladbach v Union Berlin 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
90+8' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+7' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
90+6' Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' Here is a change. Rocco Reitz is going off and Eugen Polanski gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stanley Nsoki trots off the pitch and is replaced by Dmytro Bogdanov (Union Berlin).
90+4' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Frederik Ronnow no chance!
90+4' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+3' A penalty is given to B. Monchengladbach!
90+3' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for B. Monchengladbach. Let’s see what happens!
90+1' B. Monchengladbach are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
90+1' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' A mid-range free kick is awarded to B. Monchengladbach out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
89' A yellow card for bad language! Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
89' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
88' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

86' A neat pass is well received by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
85' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Substitution. Franck Honorat makes way for Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
81' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) replacing Oliver Burke.
80' Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
79' Total attempts – 14:4.
79' Substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong walks off the pitch and Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
77' Flag up against Livan Burcu (Union Berlin). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
75' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) serves up a nice cross, but Frederik Ronnow punches the ball away.

72' Moritz Nicolas makes a brilliant save! Alex Kral (Union Berlin) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch so that Wael Mohya can be given a rest.

71' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
71' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Alex Kral (Union Berlin) replaces Aljoscha Kemlein.
70' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
68' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' The goal by B. Monchengladbach is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.

66' The B. Monchengladbach players halt their celebrations as referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
65' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
64' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
64' Yellow card. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
63' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matthias Jollenbeck no option but to blow his whistle.

60' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
60' The ball possession at the moment is 57:43.
59' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for an infringement.
58' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
56' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) gets a precise pass from the edge of the box and swiftly strikes, but his shot misses to the left of the target.
55' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
53' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
51' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
49' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Steffen Baumgart makes a switch. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is coming on in place of Christopher Trimmel at the start of the second period.
46' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker over the crossbar.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' A lofted cross from Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
43' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Union Berlin.
41' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
41' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:1.
38' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
38' The ball is cleared after Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
35' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
34' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.
33' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
33' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
29' Matthias Jollenbeck has a clear sight and sees a foul from Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
29' Neat passing move from Union Berlin in order to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' That's a clear yellow card. Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) goes into the book.
25' PENALTY APPEAL after Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
23' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
23' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
22' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
21' 67:33 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
20' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck had an easy-decision to make.

18' B. Monchengladbach slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
17' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
16' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
16' A corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is thwarted by the well prepared Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin).
15' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner kick.
13' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
12' Great teamplay by Union Berlin as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
10' The ball is laid off to Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Moritz Nicolas to make a decent save.
9' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to B. Monchengladbach.
5' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
5' B. Monchengladbach are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
2' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matthias Jollenbeck.
